client/.github/workflows/client.yml:
jobs:
  check:
      - name: Create prerelease
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo Blockfield/blockfield-releases --title "Blockfield $GITHUB_REF_NAME" --notes "Blockfield $GITHUB_REF_NAME release in progress; notes follow shortly." --prerelease --latest=false
      - name: Publish client archives
          gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo Blockfield/blockfield-releases --clobber "${files[@]}"
      - name: Release text
      - name: Publish release notes
  deploy:
    needs: check
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml
server/.github/workflows/release.yml:
jobs:
  prepare:
  release:
    needs: prepare
      - name: Create version GitHub Release
      - name: Release text
      - name: Publish release notes
            gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${files[@]}" --clobber
  deploy:
    needs: release
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml
client/.github/workflows/deploy.yml:
jobs:
  deploy:
      - name: Verify compatibility and deploy client
        id: deploy
        env:
          TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: just python scripts/deploy-client.py "$TAG"
      - name: Mark the deployed client as latest
        if: steps.deploy.outputs.served == 'true'
data=b'{"prerelease":false,"make_latest":"true"}'
server/.github/workflows/deploy.yml:
jobs:
  deploy:
      - name: Validate target and remember previous pair
        id: previous
        # ponytail: keep long code out of run blocks until actionlint fixes its pre-start stdin pipe write.
        run: just python scripts/prepare-server-deploy.py >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
server/scripts/prepare-server-deploy.py: "Server gates on another client than the served one: rerun Deploy server with client_tag "
server/.github/workflows/check.yml:
image: ${{ steps.image-scope.outputs.image }}
          tree=$(git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")
          tree=$(git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")
  image:
            tree=$(git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")
              echo "tag=candidate-$tree"
